Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: monthly expenditure envelope & procurement checkpoints

Hi Olivia — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and the ask as promised: 

1) Expected monthly token envelope (ballpark): you mentioned ~350M–900M input+output tokens depending on ramp. Can you confirm the most likely steady-state month you expect (e.g., Month 3 of pilot)?

2) Target unit economics: you said CV is aiming for ~$10–$22 / 1M tokens for inference to keep the feature accretive to your product roadmap. Can you confirm the $/1M target we should validate pricing against?

3) Procurement threshold & PO cadence: procurement asked whether a single PO for a quarterly commit or a monthly invoicing path is preferred. Which internal procurement route should we prepare (single PO, recurring POs, or credit card for pilot)?

Next steps I propose: we’ll send a tailored pricing envelope (with two commit scenarios + on-demand fallbacks) and a short SOW draft for procurement review. If that looks good, Marcus will join the procurement call to run through billing/PO details.

Attachments attached: ClearView_RW_pricing_v1.pdf (pricing envelope / scenarios), SOW_Template_ClearView_draft.docx (starter SOW).

If you can reply with the steady-state tokens and preferred PO cadence by Tuesday 2/23, we’ll prioritize the contract-side materials.

Thanks —
Irene

Subject: Re: Post-demo: monthly expenditure envelope & procurement checkpoints

Hi Irene — thanks for the clear recap and the docs. A few clarifications from our side: 

• Steady-state month: best estimate is ~600M tokens / month (we anticipate Month 3 of pilot is close to this). That assumes ~120k active users with a mix of short/long queries.

• Target $/1M: economics team is targeting $14 / 1M tokens for inference (we can stretch to $18 if we see measurable retention lift).

• Procurement path: procurement prefers a quarterly PO for committed usage above $50k/month. For the pilot (first 6–8 weeks) they will accept monthly POs or a credit-card-backed sandbox. They also asked for a short net-30 invoice term and a sample SOW with deliverables.

We’ve looped procurement to the thread; happy to set a 30-minute call later this week to run the PO/timing.

—Olivia
Olivia Barnes
Head of Product, ClearView Analytics
olivia.barnes@clearviewanalytics.com

[Procurement contact: procurement@clearviewanalytics.com]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-demo: monthly expenditure envelope & procurement checkpoints

Thanks — quick internal notes so we’re aligned before the procurement call: 

• Pricing sensitivity: Olivia’s $14 / 1M target with tolerance to $18 means we should present a three-line scenario: (1) Pilot on-demand (no commit) at $20 / 1M, (2) Quarterly commit @ 600M+ at $13.5 / 1M, (3) Annual reserved at $11 / 1M — include auto-fallback to lower-cost model variant when utilization spikes.

• PO thresholds: procurement asked that any single PO > $150k get legal review. For us, that means show an initial quarter commit that stays under $150k per PO or flag it for enterprise review.

• Billing terms: agree to offer net-30 for the pilot, but require net-45 for quarterly committed invoices unless finance approves otherwise. We should prepare a short SOW with milestones tied to pilot acceptance criteria (latency SLA and accuracy/quality checks).

Irene — I’ll join the procurement call. I’ll attach a short one-pager on commit scenarios and an annotated pricing sheet with the math for $/1M at different token volumes.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Sales — Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Hi Olivia / Procurement team — thanks for the details, that’s very helpful. Proposed next steps: 

1) Procurement sync: Thu 2/25 at 11:00 PT (30 min). I’m blocking Marcus + Neha. Please confirm or propose an alternate time.

2) Deliverables we’ll share ahead of the call (by EOD today): updated pricing envelope with the three-line scenarios Marcus outlined, an annotated SOW draft reflecting pilot deliverables and acceptance criteria, and a short invoice/PO example with line items.

3) For the pilot: we’ll default to monthly POs (to keep initial PO amounts < $150k). If ClearView signs up for quarterly commit and the PO exceeds $150k, we’ll trigger legal review and flag any potential finance terms changes.

4) Action owner table: 
   - Irene: send updated pricing + SOW (EOD today)
   - Marcus: procurement playbook + fallback routing details (call)
   - Neha: coordinate SOW redlines with finance/legal and share billing samples

Olivia — if $14 / 1M is the target we’ll build the math to show estimated monthly spend at 600M tokens (that’s ~$8,400 at $14/1M times 600 => ensure alignment — note: we’ll include both model and infra line items so totals are transparent). If anything above is off, flag it on the call.

Confirm meeting time and I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Thanks —
Irene
